definition.step: exactly one Adam step on an independent scratch model over sentence 0
definition.checkpoint: model state, optimizer state and global step in one file
definition.load: a child process restores all three and reports digests
definition.forward: the teacher-forced distribution digest after the load equals the parent's
definition.resume: one more Adam step in the child equals the parent's own second step bit for bit
definition.reject: missing key, unexpected key, random bytes and a truncated file each raise
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.gradients: every parameter Adam updates has a finite gradient; the one step changes parameters
criteria.checkpoint_file: the checkpoint exists, is non-trivial and carries schema/config/lr/global_step
criteria.child_load: child return code 0; loaded parameter digest equals the parent's after-step digest
criteria.child_forward: child forward digest equals the parent's after-step forward digest
criteria.child_resume: child second-step parameter digest equals the parent's second-step digest
criteria.adam_step: the restored Adam state reports step 1 before the child's second step
criteria.rejections: 4/4 rejection cases raise (missing, unexpected, random bytes, truncated)
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R36 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
